title: Collagen Membranes Adsorb the Transforming Growth Factor-β Receptor I Kinase-dependent Activity of Enamel Matrix Derivative
authors: Stähli A, Miron RJ, Bosshardt DD, Sculean A, Gruber R. J Periodontol. 2016 May;87(5):583-90. doi: 10.1902/jop.2016.150538.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “These in vitro findings suggest that collagen products adsorb a TGF-β receptor I kinase-dependent activity of enamel matrix derivative and make it available for potential target cells” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
